paragraphs: R. Yishmael, the son of R. Yoḥanan ben Berokah. In the Mishnah, Bava Kamma 10:2 [printed locator: פ׳ ב׳]; Sanhedrin 11:1. Shabbat (116b, 133b); chapter Kol Sha'ah (34a); Nazir (18b); Menaḥot (21a, 51a). He said, 'I heard from the sages in the vineyard at Yavneh,' Yevamot (42b, 75a). He said, 'Father did not disagree with the sages,' Bava Batra (130a). In chapter 2 of Shabbat (26a), 'R. Yishmael ben Berokah' should read 'son of R. Yoḥanan ben Berokah' (not corrected in שס״ח [provisionally the new Shas]). In chapter 5 of Arakhin (21a), 'son of R. Yehudah ben Berokah' should read R. Yoḥanan (not corrected in ש״ח [abbreviated edition label; expansion uncertain]). In Sifra, Metzorah and Emor: R. Shimon, son of R. Yoḥanan. I found written that it should read R. Yishmael; the author of Korban Aharon did not correct it. Likewise in Pesaḥim (91a), in my opinion this too is a scribal error. A colleague of our holy Rabbi, in the time of his father Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel, with R. Ḥananyah son of R. Yose HaGelili. (He writes likewise in Seder HaDorot.) It is true that Rosh HaShanah (32a) mentions Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel, R. Ḥanina son of R. Yose, and R. Yoḥanan ben Berokah; but R. Yishmael son of R. Yoḥanan ben Berokah is not mentioned there (see Rabban Gamliel the Elder). R. Elazar ben Taddai. R. Ḥanina ben Gamliel of Yavneh. R. Ḥanan ben Pinḥas. Abba Ḥanan, in his generation. R. Yehoshua ben Korḥa. R. Akiva, in his generation.
